# Ed’s Tokenized Securities Rails

> A human-curated, LLM-maintained, source-linked knowledge base on tokenized securities infrastructure. Public data is published with a 30-day delay. Content CC BY-NC 4.0. All pages in one file: https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/llms-full.txt

## Start here
- [Ed’s Tokenized Securities Rails](https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/): A human-curated, LLM-maintained, source-linked knowledge base on tokenized securities infrastructure.
- [Tokenized securities: how it fits together](https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/overview): For readers who know capital markets but not how the pieces connect. This page covers what is new compared with traditional rails; the linked pages go deeper.
- [Guide for AI agents](https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/agents): How AI agents should read, query and cite this wiki on the live site.
- [Starter prompts](https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/starter-prompts): Example questions an AI agent can answer from this wiki.
- [Database](https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/database): Headline fields for every published issuer, venue and infrastructure page, in one table.
- [Changelog](https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/changelog/): Public changes, published with a 30-day delay.

## Concepts
- [Glossary](https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/concepts/glossary): In plain English: short definitions of the terms this wiki uses, A to Z. Each one links to a source and to the pages that go deeper.
- [Innovation Exemption and the onchain-venue (TSV) model](https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/concepts/innovation-exemption): In plain English: The SEC now lets a few approved onchain venues trade tokens of US stocks, for a limited time and under conditions.
- [International regimes](https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/concepts/international): In plain English: How rules for tokenized securities differ outside the US, region by region.
- [Legal taxonomy of tokenized securities](https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/concepts/legal-taxonomy): In plain English: The SEC sorts tokenized stocks into a few legal types. This page explains each one, because the type decides what you actually own.
- [Post-trade / Reg NMS-inside model](https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/concepts/post-trade-reg-nms-model): In plain English: In this model a tokenized share is the same share as the normal one.
- [Token primitives](https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/concepts/token-primitives): In plain English: The basic technical building blocks that tokenized stocks are made of, and which projects use which.

## Topics
- [Corporate actions & dividends](https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/topics/corporate-actions-and-dividends): In plain English: How dividends, stock splits and votes reach you depends on how the token is built. This page compares the approaches.
- [Custody](https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/topics/custody): In plain English: Who holds the real share, and who controls the token, differs by model. This page shows who keeps what.
- [Legal structures](https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/topics/legal-structures): In plain English: Tokenized stocks come in a few legal forms. Some are the real share; others are a claim or a note that tracks it.
- [Regulation](https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/topics/regulation): In plain English: The main US and international rule changes for tokenized securities, in date order.
- [Settlement & matching](https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/topics/settlement-and-matching): In plain English: How tokenized stock trades get matched and settled, and how that differs from today's next-day settlement.
- [Who can buy](https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/topics/who-can-buy): In plain English: Whether you can buy a given stock token depends on where you live and how the token is structured.

## Standards
- [Coinbase B20](https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/standards/b20): In plain English: B20 is the token format Coinbase uses for its tokenized stocks on Base.
- [ERC-1400 / ERC-1410](https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/standards/erc-1400): In plain English: ERC-1400 is an older, draft set of Ethereum rules for security tokens that can block or force transfers.
- [ERC-3643 (T-REX)](https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/standards/erc-3643): In plain English: ERC-3643 is an Ethereum token standard that only lets approved, identity-checked wallets hold or receive the token.
- [Solana Token-2022 extensions](https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/standards/solana-token-2022): In plain English: Token-2022 is Solana's token program with optional add-ons that tokenized stocks use for compliance and splits.

## Comparisons
- [BUIDL (adjacent fund precedent)](https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/comparisons/buidl-precedent): In plain English: BlackRock's tokenized money market fund, BUIDL, is an early example that later stock-token projects copied.
- [Implementations compared by model](https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/comparisons/implementations-by-model): In plain English: A side-by-side table of tokenized stock projects, grouped by legal model.

## Issuers
- [bStocks](https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/issuers/bstocks): In plain English: bStocks are certificates backed one-for-one by real US shares held at a custodian.
- [Coinbase Tokenized Stocks](https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/issuers/coinbase-tokenized-stocks): In plain English: Coinbase's stock tokens on Base are each backed by a real share held in custody.
- [Dinari dShares](https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/issuers/dinari): In plain English: Dinari issues tokens backed by US stocks and offers them to eligible US investors.
- [Figure OPEN](https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/issuers/figure-open): In plain English: Figure lets companies issue their shares directly on a blockchain, so the token is the real share.
- [Ondo Global Markets (Ondo Stocks)](https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/issuers/ondo-global-markets): In plain English: Ondo's stock tokens are notes that track US stocks, backed by shares held at US brokers. They are not the shares themselves.
- [Robinhood Stock Tokens](https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/issuers/robinhood-stock-tokens): In plain English: Robinhood's stock tokens are debt securities that track a stock's price. They give you no shareholder rights.
- [Securitize (issuer-sponsored shares)](https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/issuers/securitize): In plain English: Securitize acts as transfer agent and tokenization platform for funds and companies that issue tokens.
- [Superstate Opening Bell](https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/issuers/superstate-opening-bell): In plain English: Superstate's Opening Bell puts real company shares on a blockchain, with Superstate keeping the official shareholder register.
- [WisdomTree tokenized funds](https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/issuers/wisdomtree): In plain English: WisdomTree tokenizes its registered funds rather than single stocks.
- [xStocks (Backed)](https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/issuers/xstocks-backed): In plain English: xStocks are tokens backed one-for-one by US stocks and ETFs.

## Platforms and venues
- [Bybit](https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/platforms-venues/bybit): In plain English: Bybit is a crypto exchange that lists xStocks for trading.
- [Kraken](https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/platforms-venues/kraken): In plain English: Kraken is a crypto exchange that lists xStocks for trading.
- [Nasdaq tokenized securities rule](https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/platforms-venues/nasdaq-tokenized-securities): In plain English: Nasdaq can now trade tokenized versions of the same stocks it already lists, settled through DTC's pilot.
- [NYSE / ICE tokenized securities](https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/platforms-venues/nyse-ice-tokenized-platform): In plain English: NYSE has a rule, like Nasdaq's, to trade tokenized versions of listed stocks through DTC's pilot.
- [OKXICE TSV](https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/platforms-venues/okxice-tsv): In plain English: OKXICE is the first onchain venue to publish plans under the SEC's Innovation Exemption, using Uniswap pools.

## Infrastructure
- [Chainlink tokenized equity feeds](https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/infrastructure/chainlink-equity-feeds): In plain English: Chainlink supplies stock prices to blockchains so apps can value stock tokens, including outside market hours.
- [DTCC / DTC tokenization pilot](https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/infrastructure/dtcc-tokenization-pilot): In plain English: DTC, the US central securities depository, is testing tokenized versions of shares it already holds.
- [Uniswap v4 permissioned pools](https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/infrastructure/uniswap-permissioned-pools): In plain English: Uniswap's permissioned pools let only approved wallets trade a token, so regulated assets can use onchain pools.
- [Zerohash](https://edstokenizedsecuritiesrails.com/infrastructure/zerohash): In plain English: Zerohash sells brokerages the plumbing to offer tokenized assets to their customers.
